fields.label: Control Number (Our Reference)
fields.description: OUR control number (issued via TCB) — sent to Malipopay as 'reference', stored by them as customerReference. One collection EPOCH per row: a reopen after forfeiture gets a NEW row, so this is indexed but not unique. At most one non-Dead row may exist per control number (enforced in validate).

fields.label: Malipopay Reference (ML...)
fields.description: THEIR reference, minted on collection create. Until Malipopay's Phase 2 ships, this is the only number payable at CRDB / mobile-money channels. All Malipopay read endpoints are addressed by it.

fields.label: Customer Reference (as stored by Malipopay)
fields.description: The exact customerReference Malipopay stored — proven to be verbatim what we SENT (the 2026-09-07 test bill was created with 999GVATEST0002 and stored unchanged). Lookups by customerReference must use THIS value; never reconstruct it.

fields.label: State
fields.options:
Pending Create
Creating
Active
Create Failed
Suspend Requested
Suspended
Resume Requested
Kill Requested
Dead
Needs Attention
fields.description: OUR lifecycle for this epoch. 'Creating' is the write-ahead intent around the non-idempotent create call; 'Kill Requested' means the TCB number died and the Malipopay bill must die (their poll of reference_status is the Phase-1 kill mechanism); 'Dead' is terminal — a reopen mints a new epoch row.

fields.label: Amount Billed (TZS)
fields.description: Integer TZS sent on create — Malipopay accepts no decimals or separators.

fields.label: Maintenance Hold (Surgery)
fields.description: Set by the operator as step 0 of any money surgery touching this order. While set: reference_status answers 'inconclusive' (their contract keeps the bill open, collects nothing against stale data), sweeps skip this collection, webhook events queue without booking. Clear when the surgery is complete.

fields.label: Provider Snapshot (display only — never drives closure)
Provider Status
fields.description: Their last reported status (PROCESSING / PARTIAL / SUCCESSFUL / ...). Display only: closure is driven from breakdown fullyPaid / outstanding, never from status — per the integration contract.

fields.label: Payment Link
fields.description: Shareable payment page returned on create (link.co.tz/...) — can be sent to the customer.

fields.label: Last Polled By Malipopay
fields.description: Last reference_status hit for this control number. Their polling IS the Phase-1 kill mechanism — if a live collection stops being polled, dead bills stay payable and nobody notices; the sweep alerts on stale values.
